name: Replace the Claude Design loop with a repo-file design contract and a design subagent
objective: Define the on-disk design contract a separate web dashboard reads (each product repo holds its projects, rounds, numbered cards, tokens and decisions in git); add a dedicated design subagent that drafts rounds into it, using frontend-design only where it helps; rewrite design-cowork around the files, retiring the DesignSync read-back and SIGNOFF regroup and keeping Claude Design only as an optional bundle import; reword the executor hard rule to 'the design subagent drafts, the operator decides'; ship a hook that registers a repo with the dashboard. Governance unchanged (styles, rounds, literal signoff, mockup gate, RESPECT THE DESIGN); Claude Code only; no interim viewer (card files are opened directly); the dashboard is built in its own repo.

acceptance.note: workspace machinery only: no running product surface; the design contract is reported to the operator for their dashboard build
